title: Only Accepted Tokens Count: An Energy Accounting of Speculative Decoding Under Latency Targets
abstract: arXiv:2610.40287v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language model serving is limited by facility power. Energy per token determines how many tokens a datacenter can serve, while a latency target bounds how quickly each user receives them. During decode, every weight is read from memory for every generated token. Batching amortizes this read across users but makes no individual user faster. Speculative decoding does: a drafter proposes several future tokens, and the target model verifies them in a single forward pass that reuses the same weight read. Because every drafted token must be verified whether or not it is accepted, the energy speculation saves depends on how many drafted tokens are accepted. This saving is hard to pin down. It varies across target models from different attention families and across drafting schemes, and it depends on the text being served. Every drafter we evaluate accepts fewer tokens on conversation than on code, and every trained drafter accepts fewer

translated_title: 只有被接受的Token才算数：延迟目标下投机解码的能耗核算
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型的服务受限于数据中心的设施电力。每Token的能耗决定了数据中心能够服务的Token总量，而延迟目标则限制了每个用户接收这些Token的速度。在解码阶段，每生成一个Token都需要从内存中读取一次全部权重。批处理可以将这种读取开销在多个用户之间摊销，但并不会让任何单个用户变得更快。投机解码则可以做到这一点：草稿模型提出若干未来Token，目标模型在单次前向传播中验证这些Token，从而复用同一次权重读取。由于每个草稿Token无论最终是否被接受都必须经过验证，投机解码所节省的能量取决于有多少草稿Token被接受。这种节省难以准确刻画：它随采用不同注意力架构的目标模型而变化，随不同的起草方案而变化，并且取决于所服务的文本内容。在我们评估的所有草稿模型中，其在对话文本上接受的Token数量均少于代码文本，且每个经过训练的草稿模型接受的Token数量均更少……
tldr: 本文揭示了投机解码的节能效果关键取决于草稿Token的接受数量，并在延迟目标约束下对不同注意力架构、起草方案和文本类型的能耗节省进行了系统核算。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that the energy savings of speculative decoding hinge on the number of accepted drafted tokens, and provides a systematic energy accounting under latency targets across attention architectures, drafting schemes, and text domains.
